lines.zh: 咕噜咕噜，腐肉的气味真香！
lines.en: Rumbly, that rotting flesh smells good!

lines.zh: 呼啦啦，我要吞噬你的灵魂！
lines.en: Rustle, I'll feast on your soul!
Sss, that's mine!
Sss, the power of corruption!
Huff, I'm going to eat the gold!
Sss, this is my turf!
Corruption, my power!
Rumbly, food smells good!
Sss, my treasure!

lines.zh: 呼啦啦，我要吸收你的力量！
lines.en: Rustle, I'll absorb your power!
My banner drags through the rot-soil.
I crush the fungus grass into purple mud.
Fungal grass up to my knees, and no one tends it.
Under these mushroom caps, this patch is mine.
Corruption spreads, I harvest!
Rumbly, waiting for prey!
Gold, my prey!
These stems are thick enough to lean on.
I'm the ruler of this wasteland!
Rumbly, enjoy the corruption!
On the fungal plain, there is rotten flesh enough.
Corruption, my power source!
I murmur to the mushrooms.
A hole in the banner, but still serviceable.
I wait for the next offering.
Golden stew bubbles in my little pot.
This rotten flesh feels neither ache nor itch.
I count the rings on the mushroom stems.
A cultist's banner does not fall.
The wind of the Fungus Plains is purple.
Prey, there!
I'm on you now!
Your scent, my prey!
Come, I'll eat you!
Corrupted soul, my prey!
Living scent - fresher than carrion.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在菌毯上了。
lines.en: Your shadow has fallen on my fungal mat.
My prey, right in front!

lines.zh: 你的气息，就是我的猎物！
lines.en: Your scent, my prey!

lines.zh: 我腐坏得连旗子也拿不稳。
lines.en: I've rotted too far to hold the banner.

lines.zh: 你没带旗子，那就糟糕了。
lines.en: You carry no banner. That is unfortunate.
You crushed a mushroom underfoot.
My flesh is torn...
It hurts like death, and I am still standing.
What's happening...
Give me the golden stew...

lines.zh: 金汤洒了，我连碗都端不稳。
lines.en: My golden stew spilled; I cannot hold the bowl.

lines.zh: 我的腐肉护不住骨头了...
lines.en: My rotten flesh can't cover my bones anymore.
Don't kill me...

lines.zh: 金汤洒了，我站都站不稳。
lines.en: My golden stew spilled - I can barely stand.
I beg you...
My golden stew spilled. It cannot be refilled...

lines.zh: 腐肉吸引你接近，小心金汤陷阱！
lines.en: The flesh lures you near, beware the golden stew trap!

lines.zh: 金粒闪耀，诱惑着你踏入陷阱！
lines.en: Glinting gold grains tempt you into the trap!

lines.zh: 这腐肉看起来可口，但别吃！
lines.en: That flesh looks good, but don't eat it!

lines.zh: 腐烂的金子，让人难以抗拒！
lines.en: Rotten gold, hard to resist!
Will you get golden stew if you approach me?
Look at my gold grains, greedy!

lines.zh: 腐肉散发着诱惑的香气！
lines.en: The flesh emits an enticing aroma!

lines.zh: 别让腐肉迷惑你的心智！
lines.en: Don't let the flesh cloud your mind!

lines.zh: 你无法抗拒这腐肉的香味！
lines.en: You can't resist the flesh's fragrance!
Greedy, the flesh is before you!

lines.zh: 猪灵邪教徒撞击你，你倒下了！
lines.en: A Zombified Piglin Cultist collides with you, and you fall!

lines.zh: 被撞击后，你感到一阵剧痛！
lines.en: A sharp pain after being collided with!

lines.zh: 避开猪灵邪教徒的撞击！
lines.en: Avoid the Zombified Piglin Cultist's collision!

lines.zh: 猪灵邪教徒冲向你，你躲闪不及！
lines.en: The Zombified Piglin Cultist charges at you, and you can't dodge!

lines.zh: 撞击的力量让你头晕目眩！
lines.en: The force of the collision leaves you dizzy!

lines.zh: 猪灵邪教徒的撞击让你踉跄后退！
lines.en: The Zombified Piglin Cultist's collision makes you stagger back!

lines.zh: 你被猪灵邪教徒撞飞了！
lines.en: You are knocked away by a Zombified Piglin Cultist!

lines.zh: 猪灵邪教徒撞击你，你被击退！
lines.en: The Zombified Piglin Cultist collides with you, pushing you back!

lines.zh: 躲开猪灵邪教徒的猛烈撞击！
lines.en: Avoid the fierce collision of the Zombified Piglin Cultist!

lines.zh: 猪灵邪教徒的撞击让你难以站稳！
lines.en: The Zombified Piglin Cultist's collision makes it hard for you to stand!

lines.zh: 求偶声中，猪灵邪教徒显得更加凶猛！
lines.en: The mating call makes the Zombified Piglin Cultist more aggressive!

lines.zh: 猪灵邪教徒发出求偶的低吼！
lines.en: A low rumble of mating desire!

lines.zh: 求偶声吸引更多的猪灵邪教徒！
lines.en: The mating call attracts more Zombified Piglin Cultists!

lines.zh: 猪灵邪教徒的求偶声让人心慌！
lines.en: The mating call makes hearts flutter!

lines.zh: 求偶的猪灵邪教徒更显凶猛！
lines.en: The Zombified Piglin Cultist sounds more fierce in mating!

lines.zh: 猪灵邪教徒的求偶声回荡在平原上！
lines.en: The mating call echoes across the Fungal Plains!

lines.zh: 猪灵邪教徒用低吼求偶！
lines.en: The Zombified Piglin Cultist growls in mating desire!

lines.zh: 求偶的猪灵邪教徒显得更加强壮！
lines.en: The Zombified Piglin Cultist appears more powerful in mating!

lines.zh: 求偶声让猪灵邪教徒更加警惕！
lines.en: The mating call makes the Zombified Piglin Cultist more vigilant!

lines.zh: 求偶声中，猪灵邪教徒显得更加狂暴！
lines.en: In mating, the Zombified Piglin Cultist becomes more violent!
Taste the rotten flesh, bitter indeed.
Gold in hand, contented.
Golden stew warms the stomach.
Mushroom grass everywhere, Fungal Plains.
Hunger drives me, seeking food.
Flesh for sustenance, energy fills me.
Golden grains, treasure them.
Golden stew lures, must be cautious.
Mushrooms provide cover.
Rotten flesh, a chance to survive.
Prey approaches, one strike kills.
Flesh lure, hard to resist.
Kill begins, survivors are enemies.
Golden grains, target locked.
Golden stew, close the gap.
Prey shakes, fear grips.
Flesh attracts, near danger.
Golden grains, fight's will.
Golden stew, battle call.
Killing无情, survivors are foes.

lines.zh: 我这一箭，能穿透两具猎物。
lines.en: One arrow of mine pierces two prey.
Target heart, fatal strike.
Target head, no escape.
Target gold, one strike.
Target flesh, hunger's source.
Target stew, kiss of death.
Target, fearless strike.
Target flesh, greed's source.
Target gold, wealth's source.
The golden stew wants a longer simmer.

lines.zh: 我咬开你的护甲，尝金味。
lines.en: I bite through your armor and taste gold.
More rotting flesh, please!
I need flesh to nourish!
Taste the rot!
Gold, my sustenance!
My rotten hand comes down in a spray of fungus.
Flesh and gold, my prey!
I'll use you to stew some gold!
My fleshed hand!
Not enough gold for you!
In darkness, we rise!
From the tainted earth, we grow!
Mushroom Fields, our home!
Hunger calls to us!
Flesh and gold, we crave!
The warmth of the stew, we desire!
Gold glimmers, we feast!
Flesh nourishes, we strengthen!
In the dark, we congregate!
Gold, our food!
The rot-soil parts and a banner rises.
We step out from under the mushroom caps.

lines.zh: 我的金汤在火里滚开了。
lines.en: My golden stew is boiling in the fire.
Spilled my golden stew; what a waste.

lines.zh: 水灌进肺里，连腐肉都泡涨了。
lines.en: Water in my lungs, even the rot is bloated.
My golden stew spilled before I could drink.

lines.zh: 箭扎进腐肉，拔出来发臭。
lines.en: The arrow sinks into dead flesh and comes out reeking.
Magic strikes me...
I'm starved...

lines.zh: 雷顺着金粒烧进我的肉。
lines.en: Lightning runs down my gold bits into my flesh.

lines.zh: 腐肉配金汤，就是我的一餐。
lines.en: Rotten flesh and golden stew, my meal.
